items.title: Lifting maps from a perfect object defined on a quasi-compact open of an affine scheme after tensoring with a Koszul swindle

items.difficulty_reason: 28 行、Koszul 挠技巧的标准应用：①affine 上 perfect-affine + affine-compare 把 E、E' 写成模复形；②Hom_A(M, M') 复形表示内 Hom（Rhom-strictly-perfect 引理），α 成为 R SheafHom(E,E') 在 U 上的截面 s（section-RHom-over-U 引理）；③represent-cohomology-class-on-open 命题：拟紧开上的截面由高次幂 Koszul 复形 I(f_1^e,…,f_r^e) 的映射 ξ 表示；④E_1 = Tot(I ⊗ M)：经典映射 I → A 给 β: E_1 → E，ξ 给 γ: E_1 → E'；在 U 上 Koszul 复形局部零伦 ⇒ β|_U 同构且 α = γ∘β^{-1}。承重全在 span 内；5 处引用（3 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-lift-map (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3570-3583

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the module representations of E and E' over the affine ring, the identification of the map alpha with a section of the internal Hom over U, the representation of that section by a map from a Koszul complex of high powers of the covering equations, and the assembly of the lifted perfect object E_1 as the tensor product with the Koszul complex (source lines 3585-3612)
